name: jurisflow
description: JurisFlow - legal advice & consultation platform. Root launcher: every script delegates to frontend/ (React+Vite) or backend/ (Flask).
comment: This file has no dependencies on purpose - it only exists so `npm run dev` works from the repository root as well as from frontend/. The real app manifest is frontend/package.json.

scripts.setup: npm run install:web && npm run install:api
